decisions.reason: It supports the firm's stated push into compliance capabilities, fits its agency-focused customer base well, and its dedicated presence across 2023 and 2024 suggests sufficient strategic relevance.

This platform is central to the firm's core hosting and automation proposition, was prominent on the home page in both years, and likely strengthens customer lock-in among agencies and multi-project users.
A configurable managed hosting plan is closely aligned with the firm's main business, matches demand for scalable managed operations, and remained actively presented on its own page through 2024.

Extended PHP security support directly reinforces the firm's security and risk-reduction promise and is a sensible complementary service for hosted client projects even if it was only newly introduced in 2024.
